## Commit discipline
For every commit included in this PR:
- [ ] one attributable purpose; no unrelated scope
- [ ] traceable to an issue, checkpoint, PR, or work item
- [ ] tests/evidence stated for behavior changes
- [ ] no secrets or sensitive material introduced
- [ ] no `--no-verify`, check bypass, suppression, or auto-merge shortcut
- [ ] no work added merely to increase apparent maturity
- [ ] historical commits are not rewritten just for presentation
- [ ] claims remain below available evidence
